findings.desc: METR quote (blockquote): every second-level (○) sub-bullet escapes the blockquote and becomes a top-level <ul> outside the quote, splitting the quote into 4 fragments and losing nesting. Affected: 'As with Claude Opus 5.5, it neglects…', 'However, it’s unclear to what extent…' (children of the Sunlight bullet), '[Claude Mythos 5.2] does not reach further milestones…Gaming Bot' (child of 'Even on verifiable tasks…'), 'On Budget NanoGPT Speedrun, across all attempts…' (child of '[Claude Mythos 5.2] and Claude Opus 5.5 share similar weaknesses'). Same class also visible at the end of p.40 ('In particular, the primary way…', '[Claude Mythos 5.2] “solves a clear majority…' etc.).
